label: L=3 sequences, first copy step (re-fed first token), mostly when it is t
explanation: Very sparse (66 dev steps). Fires only at step 4 of length-3 sequences, i.e. the copy step right after <DEL>, where the model reads back the first original token and outputs the second (recall_idx 1). It never fires in any other phase, at any other step, or for any other length. Within that slot, whether it fires depends on the first token: t accounts for about 78% of activation mass and all the strongest activations; o, p, z, m, w, k give weak activations. Magnitude also depends on the second token (f, b, q, y, c, e, r, u give higher values). It mostly fires on letter-only sequences. Only about 40% of t-initial L=3 sequences fire, so the predicate is imprecise.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: t, o, p, z, m, w; least: i, x, <DEL>, h) and the third original token (most: f, n, k, a, j, u; least: r, i, g, m); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=4, L=3, t=4.
